title: 第22章 功法管控！
novel_title: 从暮年娶妻到长生不死
content_zh:
众所周知，修士最大的执念，就是突破境界，幻破粉恰恰能虚假满足这一点愿望。

    对那些卡在瓶颈多年不得寸进的修士，简直是必杀。

    沈云嗫嚅着嘴角，良久才吐出一句，“岂不是祸害无穷。”

    “嘘！这可不兴说，据说是天工府大人物创造出的配方。”

    “而且我也是猜测，说不定真能突破呢？”

    林巧娘用着她都不信的语气说道。

    “如果真有用，王轩不会吃了半年还没效果了。”

    沈云心里想着，以后打死都不能碰这玩意。

    誓与赌毒不共戴天。

    两人正说着话，旁边忽然探出个扎着双丫髻的小姑娘。

    十三四岁的年纪，白玉似的胳膊正乖乖环着母亲的手腕，裙摆上绣的小蝴蝶随着她轻微的动作，像是要振翅飞起来。

    她那双眼丹凤眼生得极妙，眼尾微微上挑却没半分媚气，反倒像浸在清泉里的黑曜石，亮得能照见人影。

    小脸还带着未褪的婴儿肥，透着健康的粉白，鼻尖小巧挺翘，嘴唇是自然的樱粉色。

    明明是初见雏形的美人模样，偏生因为那份怯生生的乖巧，更添了几分惹人疼爱的稚气。

    “桐桐真可爱，来，给你糖吃。”

    沈云瞧着喜欢，当即弓下身子，从口袋里摸出几块裹着透明糖纸的灵芽糖，递到她面前。

    糖纸在光下闪闪发亮，映得她长睫忽闪了两下，像只受惊的小蝴蝶。

    “谢、谢谢爷爷……”

    她的声音细弱蚊呐，小手却牢牢抓着母亲的衣角没松开，另一只肉乎乎的小手攥成半拳，指尖悄悄蹭了蹭嘴角。

    眼里分明映着糖纸的光，却还是规矩地补充道，“桐桐刚吃过饭，不能再吃糖啦。”

    沈云脸上的笑容猛地一僵，随即有点哭笑不得——之前桐桐见婉儿叫自己姐姐，这小丫头倒是直接喊上爷爷了。

    林巧娘在一旁看得好笑，伸手轻轻捏了捏女儿的发髻，柔声道：“桐桐，该叫叔叔才对。”

    小姑娘闻言，脸颊倏地泛起更深的红晕，慌忙低下头，细声细气地更正：“谢...谢谢叔叔……”

    .....

    第二天一早巡视灵田时候，沈云再见到了王轩，和以前没什么区别。

    依旧是那个只会炼制辟谷丹的王道友，别人嘲笑也不恼。

    一月外出采一次药，炼制辟谷丹为生。

    赚的比看守灵田多，但大部分积蓄都投入幻破草上了。

    “我先看守灵田去了。”

    简单打了个招呼，沈云转身就走了。

    “奇怪，几日没见沈老头对我多了几分生疏。”

    王轩还有些疑惑，不知道为何会这样。

    左右不过是个养体一重的老头，他也懒得多想，赶快回家炼辟谷丹。

    多赚些金子，再用几次幻破粉，肯定能突破成为受人尊敬的入阶丹师。
content_en:
As we all know, the biggest obsession of monks is to break through the realm, and Huanpofen can falsely satisfy this wish.

    It is a sure kill for those monks who have been stuck in a bottleneck for many years and cannot make any progress.

    Chen Yun muttered the corner of his mouth, and after a long time he uttered, "Wouldn't it be an endless disaster?"

    "Hush! It's not fun to say this. It is said that the formula was created by a big shot in Tiangong Mansion."

    "And I'm just guessing, maybe it can really break through?"

    Lin Qiaoniang said in a tone that even she didn't believe.

    "If it was really useful, Wang Xuan wouldn't have taken it for half a year and still had no effect."

    Chen Yun thought to himself that he would not be able to touch this thing even if he was beaten to death.

    I vow to be sworn in with gambling and drugs.

    The two of them were talking when a little girl wearing a double bun suddenly poked out from beside them.

    At the age of thirteen or fourteen, her white jade-like arms were obediently wrapped around her mother's wrist. The small butterfly embroidered on her skirt seemed to be flapping its wings and flying with her slight movements.

    Her phoenix eyes were extremely beautiful. The ends of her eyes were slightly raised, but they were not charming at all. On the contrary, they were like obsidian soaked in a clear spring, so bright that they could illuminate the figures of people.

    The little face still has the baby fat that has not faded away, showing a healthy pinkish white, the tip of the nose is small and straight, and the lips are a natural cherry pink.

    She is obviously a beauty who has just begun to take shape, but because of her timid and well-behaved appearance, she has an endearing childishness.

    "Tongtong is so cute. Come on, let me give you some candy."

    Seeing that Chen Yun liked it, he immediately bent down, took out a few pieces of Lingya candy wrapped in transparent candy wrappers from his pocket, and handed them to her.

    The candy wrapper shone in the light, making her long eyelashes flicker twice, like a frightened little butterfly.

    "Thank you, thank you grandpa..."

    Her voice was weak, but her little hand firmly grasped the corner of her mother's clothes without letting go. Her other fleshy little hand was clenched into a half-fist, and her fingertips gently rubbed the corner of her mouth.

    The light of the candy wrapper was clearly reflected in her eyes, but she still added politely, "Tongtong has just eaten, so he can't eat any more candy."

    The smile on Chen Yun's face suddenly froze, and then he felt a bit dumbfounded - Tongtong saw Wan'er calling her sister before, but this little girl directly called her grandpa.

    Lin Qiaoniang looked on amusedly. She reached out and gently pinched her daughter's bun, and said softly: "Tongtong, you should call me uncle."

    When the little girl heard this, a deeper blush suddenly appeared on her cheeks. She hurriedly lowered her head and corrected in a low voice: "Thank you... thank you, uncle..."

    .....

    When inspecting the spiritual field early the next morning, Shen Yun saw Wang Xuan again, no different from before.

    He is still the Taoist Wang who only knows how to refine Bigu Pills, and he is not annoyed when others laugh at him.

    I go out once a month to collect medicine and make a living by refining Bigu Pill.

    I earn more than guarding the spiritual field, but most of my savings are invested in Huanpocao.

    "I'm going to guard the spiritual field first."

    After saying a simple hello, Shen Yun turned around and left.

    "It's strange. I haven't seen Old Man Shen in a few days, and he's a little more unfamiliar with me."

    Wang Xuan is still a little confused and doesn't know why this is happening.

    He was just an old man with a healthy body. He was too lazy to think about it and hurried home to refine Bigu Pill.

    Earn more gold and use the magic powder a few times, and you will definitely be able to break through and become a respected advanced alchemist.
